A wild set loaded with all-time favorites, the Pokémon TCG: Hidden Fates expansion is a collector’s dream and a player’s paradise! With an incredible new TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX trio, more powerful Pokémon-GX, and Shiny Pokémon galore, players will be able to discover their own Hidden Fates!

products.name: Hidden Fates Booster Pack Art Bundle [Set of 4]
products.clean_name: Hidden Fates Booster Pack Art Bundle [Set of 4]

ext_data.CardText:
Collect each of the 4 unique art packs for Hidden Fates.
Each Hidden Fates booster pack contains 10 random cards.
Each collection contains 1 Charizard GX promo card, a jumbo promo version featuring Charizard GX, four Hidden Fates booster packs, and a PTCGO code card.
Each collection contains 1 Gyarados GX promo card, a jumbo promo version featuring Gyarados GX, four Hidden Fates booster packs, and a PTCGO code card.
Each collection contains 1 Raichu GX promo card, a jumbo promo version featuring Raichu GX, four Hidden Fates booster packs, and a PTCGO code card.

Contents:
• 10 Pokemon TCG: Hidden Fates booster packs
• A full-art foil promo card featuring Moltres & Zapdos & Articuno GX
• 65 card sleeves featuring Moltres & Zapdos & Articuno
• 45 Pokémon TCG Energy cards
• A player’s guide to the Hidden Fates expansion
• 6 damage-counter dice
• 1 competition-legal coin-flip die
• 2 acrylic condition markers and 1 acrylic TAG TEAM GX marker
• Doubles as a collector’s box—including 4 dividers to help keep it organized
• A code card for the Pokemon Trading Card Game Online
